visualCharacteristics.purpose: Degree/career finder search box with inline Search button
visualCharacteristics.description: New variant (no existing search variants in project): Single wide text input with inline Search button, centered under heading Page background, centered heading above a wide search input with Search button.

cells: URL of the search/results endpoint (source form submits to the degree finder)

contentPattern.structure: link to the results page (an empty query parameter such as ?query= sets the parameter name, default q); optional plain-text row for the placeholder (e.g. "e.g. Business"); optional "Button: <label>" row

usage: Place under a default-content heading such as "Find your degree or career".
reuseGuidance: Reuse for any single-field site or course search that redirects to a results page.
